what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 1 of 2: A walk blind to a varying rotation of its coin axes beyond first order. SETTING (blocks 53-65 of the source-link direction; open PRs #8568, #8570, #8571, #8573, #8578, #8579, #8581, #8590, #8591, #8592, #8593, #8595 #8596; all rest on SUPPLIED clauses, not adopted; read the notes on those PR branches before starting, in particular blocks 62-65). Block 54's walk H = sum_a sigma_a S_a, S_a = (T_a - T_a^dagger)/(2i), the qubit as coin. Block 62: a frame for the coin; uniform frame H^2 = g^ij sin k_i sin k_j. Block 63 (exact identities, every state): the momentum density pi_j = Re psi^dagger S_j psi is conserved with a three-site BOND current J_a^j(x -> x+e_a) = (1/2) Re[psi^dagger(x+e_a) sigma_a (S_j psi)(x) + (S_j psi)^dagger(x+e_a) sigma_a psi(x)]; a relabelling G_xi = (1/2) sum {xi_j, S_j} generates i[H, G_xi] = sum sigma_a (1/2){C_a[d_a xi_j], S_j} (C_a[v] the symmetric hop along a weighted by the bond function v): second-neighbour reach; for a plane-wave pair J = exp(i q_a/2) cos(kbar_a) Theta (Theta the site response); d(psi^dagger sigma_c psi)/dt = 2 sum eps_cad Theta_d^a - [b_c(x) - b_c(x - e_c)], b_c = Re psi^dagger(x) psi(x+e_c). Block 64: strains B_a^j on bonds with H[B] = H + sum sigma_a (1/2){C_a[B_a^j], S_j}; curls F_ab^j = d_a B_b^j - d_b B_a^j blind to relabellings; field equations of any function of the curls divergence-free; among two-derivative densities of a frame, POINTWISE blindness to e -> R(x) e leaves det e and D* = det e [T1/4 + T2/2 - T3] - 2 div(det e V) = -sqrt(g) R[e^T e], so with F = sum_x w_x D_x (block 60) beta = 1 is forced; T5: the response to a rotation of a site's three forward bonds, J_a^j(x) - J_j^a(x), is non-zero on stationary states. Block 65: -(i/2)[theta.sigma, H] = (1/2) sum_j {(theta x e_j).sigma, S_j} + (1/2) sum_a C_a[d_a theta_a]; the blind walk H[vartheta] with that scalar hop; response (1/2) d(psi^dagger sigma_c psi)/dt, zero on stationary states; first order around the identity frame only. Exact arithmetic wherever a statement is claimed (Gaussian rationals; the exactly stationary state on a 4x4x4 torus with wave numbers pi/2 and coins (1,1), (1,i), (1,0) is a useful tool); floating point only as evidence, labelled so. TASK: block 65 T2 is first order around the identity frame; block 65 N1.3: for a varying frame the naive weight d_j(theta.E^j) fails. (a) Construct a nearest-neighbour hermitian generator with a rotation R_a(x) in SU(2) carried along each bond, H = sum_a (1/(2i)) [psi^dagger(x) M_a(x) V_a(x) psi(x+e_a) - h.c.], that is EXACTLY covariant under psi -> U(x) psi with V_a -> U(x) V_a U^dagger(x+e_a) and M_a -> U M_a U^dagger. (b) Show that block 65's H[vartheta] is its first-order expansion when V_a is built from the sites' rotations, and identify the scalar hop in it. (c) If V_a is a function of the frame (no new field), which function? Compare with the frame's curl (block 64) and say whether 'no new field' is possible at second order. (d) Parked decision 4 (a larger one-site algebra) must not be touched: everything stays in M_2(C). DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/the-blind-walk-beyond-first-order/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route.
